entries.german: Protocollum continatum a 10. Juli 1602 usque ad finem Instantiae in Sachen des Schäfers Claus Beck [Beckh] zu Frauental contra den Johanniterkomtur von Rosenbach wegen Schaftriebs
entries.english: Continued protocol from 10 July 1602 through the end of the instance in the matter of the shepherd Claus Beck [Beckh] of Frauental against the Hospitaller commander von Rosenbach concerning sheep-driving rights.
